ONCE UPON A TENTH BIRTHDAY

✦ ONCE UPON A TENTH BIRTHDAY ✦

An extraordinary tale for

the wonderfulHessa

✧

The Secret of
the Tenth Star

Not all adventures begin with a map. Some begin when a girl opens a book… and the stars begin to whisper.

✦ 10 years of magic · November 10

Psst… a little secret is hidden in the final pages.

WHERE STORIES COME ALIVE
✧✧
CHAPTER I ✦ THE BEGINNING

The library between the stars

Once upon a time, in a world tucked between dreams and moonlight, there lived a girl named Hessa.

She loved stories of impossible kingdoms, secret doors, and magic that appeared when you least expected it.

One evening, a lavender book slipped from a very high shelf. Its cover shimmered with ten tiny golden stars.

“For the girl who believes there is always another adventure…”

And just like that, the first star began to glow.

TAP A LANTERN TO SEE A MEMORY
✧✧
CHAPTER II ✦ THE JOURNEY

The forest of ten little lights

Beyond the library, a silver path wound into a forest where the trees wore crowns of starlight.

One by one, ten lanterns rose into the night — one for every wonderful year of Hessa's story.

✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦✦

The tenth lantern was brighter than the rest. Beneath it was a note, written in shimmering gold:

“The loveliest magic isn't found. It's carried inside you.”
✦ ✧ ✦
✦
THE MIRROR BETWEEN TWO WORLDS
✧✧
CHAPTER III ✦ THE MIRROR

The girl inside the story

A silver mirror shimmered between the trees. On one side was a world of castles and moonbeams; on the other was the most important part of the story: Hessa herself.

The mirror had a secret: the magic was never only in the storybook. It lived in the girl who opened it.

Slide the little golden star on the picture to travel between the enchanted illustration and real life.

“You were always the heroine, Hessa.”
THREE GIFTS FROM THE GARDEN
✧✧
CHAPTER IV ✦ FIVE WISHES

The garden of impossible things

In the heart of the garden stood five golden doors. Behind each one waited a wish for your next chapter.

Five golden keys hold five birthday wishes. Open them one by one, Hessa.

Five wishes are waiting behind these golden doors…

And just beyond the garden, Hessa discovered a golden gallery of memories.

A GALLERY OF PRECIOUS MOMENTS
✧✧
CHAPTER V ✦ GOLDEN MEMORIES

A thousand little wonders

The magical gallery held six beautiful moments from the heroine's life. Each picture was a little world of its own.

There were smiles, adventures, discoveries, and days worth remembering forever.

Tap any framed memory to look a little closer.

“The happiest stories are made of moments like these.”
THE SECRET IS ALMOST HERE
✧✧
CHAPTER VI ✦ THE TENTH STAR

The wish that lit the sky

High above the clouds, the ten stars formed a sparkling crown. They had been waiting for one very special day.

The stars spoke together: “Ten years of growing, dreaming, learning, and becoming. And the best chapters are still unwritten.”

A little starlight is waiting for your touch.

But one star remained quiet. It was waiting to hear a very special wish…

✦✧✦
ONLY THE STARS KNOW YOUR WISH
✧✧
CHAPTER VII ✦ YOUR ONE WISH

A wish only you can make

At the highest star, Hessa found a tiny golden quill. It was waiting for the wish closest to her heart.

✦ Your wish has joined the stars, Hessa. May the next chapter bring wonderful possibilities. ✦

Your wish stays in this browser. It is not sent to anyone.

THE FINAL PAGE
✧✧
EPILOGUE ✦ THE SURPRISE

Every story has a secret keeper…

The book fell quiet. Its pages turned to gold, and there, between the last two pages, lay a letter.

It wasn't from a queen, a wizard, or a faraway kingdom.

It was from someone who loves the heroine of this story very, very much.

The golden seal glimmered. The letter whispered:

“Only Hessa may open this.”

One last bit of magic waits inside.

Happy 10th Birthday,
Hessa!

✧

My dearest Hessa,

I hope your life is always full of magical books, brave adventures, beautiful surprises, and dreams bigger than any kingdom.

Keep being curious. Keep believing in wonderful things. And never forget: you are the magic in your own story.

Ten years is only the beginning of all the amazing chapters waiting for you.

With all my love, always,
